crosswalks.label: Special Effects Artists and Animators
crosswalks.rationale: Special Effects Artists and Animators provides bounded occupational evidence adjacent to Technical Artist; AXM keeps the profession contract narrower and evidence-bound.

findings.summary: Technical Artist must keep craft/technical outputs, target-context evidence and adjacent professional acceptance as separate evidence surfaces.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the profession boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make source identity, target-context evidence, craft/technical output and adjacent acceptance explicit and non-interchangeable.

nonclaims: No complete Technical Artist reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
